description: Change your workspace settings. Only the fields you send change: company details, tax id, default currency, payment terms in days, invoice prefix and footer, tax on or off, tax registrations (null clears them) and the sales playbook (null resets it). Model keys are managed in the dashboard, never here. Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

company_address.description: Address with line1, line2, city, state, zip and country, each text up to 200 characters. Null resets it.

company_description.description: What the company does. Null clears it.

default_currency.description: Three-letter currency code, such as USD.

invoice_footer.description: Text at the foot of each invoice.

invoice_prefix.description: Text at the start of each invoice number.

sales_playbook.description: The sales playbook. Null resets it.

tax_enabled.description: Whether tax is added to invoices.

tax_rates.description: Tax registrations. Null clears the list.

name: update_workspace_settings
